svg.title: domeneshop-mcp — MCP server for Domeneshop domains, DNS, HTTP forwards, dynamic DNS and invoices
svg.desc: An assistant session. Asked to set up email for example.no, the assistant lists the DNS records and creates MX, SPF and DKIM records. In read-only mode, a request to delete a record is declined because the write tools are hidden.

text.tspan: Domains, DNS, HTTP forwards, dynamic DNS
and invoices — from any AI assistant.

g.text: Delete the old A record for www
read-only mode hides every write tool
I can look, but not change anything here.
